name: Northern Great Plains Program
summary: Grants for conserving and restoring grasslands and grassland wildlife in four Great Plains focal areas, including tribal prairie restoration, easements and habitat work. The 2026 round has closed.
reporting: Grantees pick the metrics that fit their project from the programme's list in NFWF's Easygrants system and report against them.

status.quote: Northern Great Plains 2026 Request for Proposals - CLOSED

deadline.quote: Full Proposal Due Date Wednesday, February 25, 2026, 11:59 PM ET

applicant_types.quote: Eligible applicants include non-profit 501(c) organizations, U.S. Federal government agencies, state government agencies, local governments, municipal governments, Tribal agencies, and educational institutions.

geography.quote: The following are the Northern Great Plains focal areas; Dakota Grasslands, Missouri-Milk River Grasslands, Nebraska Sandhills, and the Powder River-Thunder Basin Grasslands.

access.quote: Full Proposal Due Date Wednesday, February 25, 2026, 11:59 PM ET

amount.quote: individual grants typically ranging from $200,000 to $1.5 million

reporting.quote: the Northern Great Plains program has a list of metrics in Easygrants for full proposal applicants to choose from for future reporting
